name: @spec-lab/tokens
description: Constructor Lab design tokens: the DTCG source tiers plus the generated CSS (reference-based, brand + light/dark via selectors), SCSS mixins, JS token map, and Tailwind bridge — built by @spec-lab/style-dictionary.

scripts.clean: echo "no clean (generated artifacts are committed; run build to regenerate)" && exit 0
scripts.dev: echo "no dev (generated artifacts; run build)" && exit 0
scripts.lint: echo "no lint (JSON data + generated artifacts; validated via test)" && exit 0
scripts.lint:fix: echo "no lint (JSON data + generated artifacts)" && exit 0
scripts.typecheck: echo "no typecheck (JSON data + generated artifacts)" && exit 0
scripts.validate: ajv compile -s schemas/tier.schema.json --spec=draft2020 --strict=false && ajv validate -s schemas/tier.schema.json -d "tiers/primitives.json" -d "tiers/semantics.json" -d "tiers/components.json" --spec=draft2020 --strict=false
